global_identity.color_palette: Natural ingredient colors. Surface: pale stone tinted with pale blush pink #FBE3EE. Headline in dark plum #2B1226 with the key word in hot fuchsia #E6177F. global_identity.visual_style: Editorial, abundant, premium top-down still life with the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.graphic_language: Four small rounded pills, clean headline on open surface, no other graphics.

creative_objective: Answer the doubt «does it really work?» by showing what is inside: the bottle as hero, surrounded by its three plant ingredients and capsules, so the viewer sees a real, natural triple-action formula.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The bottle lying diagonally in the center. 2) The four abundant ingredient piles. 3) The headline at the top. 4) The four pill labels.
art_direction.composition_style: Strict 90-degree overhead organic frame: bottle in the center rotated about 18 degrees off vertical, four generous piles entering from the four corners and cropped by the edges, a few stray pieces drifting toward the bottle, headline on clear surface at the top.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline 4-15% of the height, 8-92% of the width. Bottle 32-68% of the width and 24-80% of the height. Piles: upper-left 0-28% x 18-44%; upper-right 72-100% x 18-44%; lower-left 0-30% x 66-100%; lower-right 70-100% x 66-100%. Upper labels at 45-50% of the height, lower labels at 59-64%, within 4-28% or 72-96% of the width.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft diffused overhead daylight from the upper left, short soft shadows toward the lower right, deep focus edge to edge, rich true-to-life textures.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 editorial top-down flatlay photo, strict 90-degree overhead camera. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. The product is a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. The bottle lies flat in the center of a pale honed stone surface tinted soft blush pink, rotated about 18 degrees off vertical, front label facing the camera and fully readable, occupying about 32-68% of the width and 24-80% of the height. From the four corners, abundant organic piles cropped by the canvas edges: upper-left, whole glossy reddish-brown scaly aguaje fruits and a few halved ones showing bright orange-yellow flesh, with pieces of green palm leaf (#5E7A3A, #B5552B tones); upper-right, a generous pile of small golden-amber fenugreek seeds with a little powder; lower-left, small round black-purple maca roots, one cut open, and a mound of dark maca powder; lower-right, a loose pile of plain opaque capsules with no printing. A few seeds, a pinch of powder and two capsules drift toward the bottle without touching the label. Four small same-size rounded hot fuchsia #E6177F pills with white semi-bold text label the piles: under the two upper piles and above the two lower piles, facing the center, never touching the bottle. At the top center, on clear surface, a large two-line extra-bold headline in dark plum #2B1226 with the words 'Triple acción' in hot fuchsia. Soft diffused daylight from the upper left, short soft shadows toward the lower right, deep focus, rich realistic textures, natural appetizing colors. No people, no hands, no extra props, no other text.
